meaning:
κατα-βάλλω
[in LXX chiefly for נָפַל hi. ;]
1. to cast down, prostrate: metaphorically, pass., 2Co.4:9.
2. to put down, lay down: metaphorically, mid., with accusative, θεμέλιον, Heb.6:1.†
(AS)
